description:
A researcher needs to update the publication dates of four key papers in the library to include the exact month and day. The current records only have the year.

Your task is to locate these papers and update their 'Date' field with the specific dates provided below:

1. Find 'Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid' (Watson & Crick)
   - Change Date to: April 25, 1953

2. Find 'Deep Learning' (LeCun, Bengio, & Hinton)
   - Change Date to: May 28, 2015

3. Find 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al.)
   - Change Date to: June 12, 2017

4. Find 'Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search' (Silver et al.)
   - Change Date to: January 28, 2016

You can enter the dates in any standard format (e.g., '1953-04-25', 'April 25, 1953', '25 Apr 1953'). Ensure you press Enter or click away to save the changes.
